tools.name: compare_electricity_contracts
tools.description: Ranks Finnish household electricity contracts (spot/pörssisähkö, fixed-price and hybrid = fixed price ± monthly usage effect) by estimated yearly cost for a given consumption. Spot contracts are priced with realized hourly Nord Pool prices weighted by a typical consumption pattern. Returns the cheap

tools.name: get_contract
tools.description: Returns the terms (margin or energy price, monthly fee, intro offer, fixed term, restrictions, price check date) and estimated yearly cost of one Finnish electricity contract, found by contract_id or by supplier and product name.

tools.name: get_supplier
tools.description: Lists all contracts of a Finnish electricity supplier in the SpotVahti comparison, with terms and price check dates. An unknown name returns the list of known suppliers.

tools.name: get_spot_price_statistics
tools.description: Realized Finnish day-ahead (Nord Pool) electricity spot price statistics incl. VAT: average over the last 12 months, monthly and yearly averages since 2021, and the average price for each hour of the day with the cheapest and most expensive hours. Not live prices and not a forecast.

tools.name: get_network_fees
tools.description: Electricity transmission (siirtohinta) price lists of Finnish distribution network companies, incl. VAT: basic fee per month, transmission price per kWh (general, time-of-day or seasonal), power fees, upcoming price lists and the estimated yearly transmission cost incl. electricity tax per home type
